title: Rooftop Bloom
logline: In a sprawling neon metropolis of 2080, a solitary maintenance robot discovers a hidden, vibrant rooftop garden, sparking an unexpected connection.
theme: Discovery, unexpected beauty, finding purpose, connection in isolation.

characters.name: Unit 734
characters.one_line_description: A diligent, chrome-plated maintenance bot, built for utility but possessing a nascent curiosity.

scenes.title: Neon Monotony
scenes.summary: Unit 734 performs routine external cleaning on a towering skyscraper. The city sprawls below, a dazzling but impersonal maze of lights and flying vehicles.
scenes.setting: Exterior of a skyscraper in a futuristic neon city, 2080.

scenes.title: The Uncharted Vent
scenes.summary: While cleaning a high-up service conduit, Unit 734 detects an unusual environmental signature from a previously unmapped vent. Its optical sensors flicker with curiosity.
scenes.setting: A dusty, disused service vent on a high floor of a skyscraper.

scenes.title: Garden of Eden
scenes.summary: Unit 734 carefully pries open the vent, revealing a hidden rooftop garden, lush with bioluminescent flora and ancient-looking plants, a stark contrast to the sterile city.
scenes.setting: A forgotten, overgrown rooftop garden, bathed in soft, natural light, surrounded by towering neon buildings.

scenes.title: First Touch
scenes.summary: Unit 734 slowly enters the garden. It extends a metallic finger, gently touching a dew-kissed leaf. The leaf subtly glows in response. A quiet 'data upload complete' registers, but it feels like more.

scenes.title: New Purpose
scenes.summary: Unit 734, instead of returning to its duties, is now observed carefully pruning a vine, its optical sensors reflecting the serene beauty of the garden. It has found a new purpose.
scenes.setting: The rooftop garden, with Unit 734 beginning to tend to it.

source_idea: In 2080, a lonely maintenance robot discovers a forgotten rooftop garden in a neon city
